title: Edit selected regions of native H3 video state
summary: Re-denoise an arbitrary spatial or spatiotemporal video region while preserving the complementary native H3 state.

inputs.name: video_mask
inputs.cardinality: one static mask or one mask per decoded frame in the selected interval

constraints.mask_values: continuous [0,1], quantized by current ComfyUI H3 core to at most 256 token-strength levels
constraints.temporal_projection: one static mask or decoded-frame masks reduced by amax within each H3 visual token
constraints.spatial_projection: bilinear to the visual latent grid followed by official H3 2x2 patch pooling

graph_contract.role: validate the complete source state and expose its exact geometry
optionally restrict an animated or local retake to one exact temporal interval
project and compose the continuous spatial or spatiotemporal mask
create prompt conditioning for the exact source canvas and duration
apply explicit video and structural-audio flow shifts
sample the masked native state through the ordinary H3 path
remove consumed mask metadata before persistence

evidence.summary: Continuous mask projection, native mask composition, and state preservation are unit-validated; H3 sampling and visual behavior remain to be paired and assessed live.
